## Owner-ruled first inclusion on develop: filing-upstream-prs

The `filing-upstream-prs` skill landed on `main` via PR #130 (squash `4fed665`), which was already open when the 2026-11-08 branch model took effect and so finished on main under the grandfather clause. The develop bootstrap (PR #131, `0f5b652`) predated #130, so `develop` — now the default branch and version of record — is missing the skill from both its sync scope and its skills tree. Pratik ruled 2026-11-08: land it on develop. This PR mirrors #130's change set exactly, based on develop.

### Diff summary (the merge evidence — read it, per the sync standard)

- `.github/skills-sync-scope.txt`: +1 — `filing-upstream-prs` added to [skills] (line 50, ahead of `filing-validated-issues`, matching main).
- `skills/filing-upstream-prs/SKILL.md`: added, 134 lines, byte-identical to the live working copy and to main's copy (sha256 `259551e8d2fbde6c81aeff867f22f7f8fd8c7521368d2824fc0bd52623f05293`).
- `.github/skills-manifest.sha256`: regenerated in the worktree — 177 → 178 entries; post-write `--check` passes (OK: 178 manifest entries match the tree). No content-rule exclusions; no previously listed file dropped.

### Notes

- The commit carries the standard sync subject so the daily sync's drift-direction guard classifies this file's history correctly on develop.
- Merging is gated as usual: CI green on the final head, Codex clean on that head, zero unresolved threads.
